en.headline: Cycling federation apologises after pilot car error skips Ting Kau Bridge
en.dek: The Cycling Association of Hong Kong, China said a lead vehicle misjudged the route after cones were moved for an earlier accident, sending 32km riders the wrong way and causing bottlenecks.
body: The Cycling Association of Hong Kong, China issued an apology on Sunday evening after a pilot car for the 32-kilometre category of the Hong Kong Cyclothon failed to follow the planned route over Ting Kau Bridge.

The association said two riders in the 56-kilometre group were injured between 7am and 7:15am while heading toward the bridge. Staff moved traffic cones at the entrance to the Nam Wan Tunnel to open an emergency lane for an ambulance.

Because the cones had been repositioned, the pilot car for the 32-kilometre group mistakenly believed the route to the bridge had changed and continued straight toward the tunnel instead. The downhill section meant following riders had to stay with the vehicle for safety, missing the bridge section.

The association said the error deprived participants of the planned experience on the landmark bridge and caused a brief bottleneck. Some riders later reported having to push their bikes toward the finish line. The association expressed sincere regret for the disappointment and inconvenience.

zh.headline: 單車總會就領航車誤判致歉 32公里組錯失汀九橋
zh.dek: 中國香港單車總會表示，因早前意外需移動雪糕筒開通緊急通道，32公里組領航車誤判路線，未轉入汀九橋並造成短暫堵塞。
body: 中國香港單車總會周日傍晚就香港單車節32公里組別領航車未能按原定路線經汀九橋致歉。
總會表示，上午7時至7時15分期間，兩名56公里組單車手在前往汀九橋路段時意外受傷。現場工作人員臨時移動南灣隧道入口的雪糕筒，開通緊急通道讓救護車進入。
由於雪糕筒位置調整，32公里組領航車誤以為前往汀九橋的路線已改動，改為直行往南灣隧道。現場為下斜路段、車速較高，為確保安全，緊隨的參加者亦只能跟隨，因而錯失汀九橋路段。
總會指事件令參加者錯失標誌性賽道體驗並帶來短暫路段堵塞，有車手其後需推車完賽。總會對此帶來的失望與不便致以誠摩歉意。
